page: Microsoft Azure NC36ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine architecture deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration supplies 36 dedicated Intel virtual CPUs paired with 132.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core ratio of 3.67 GB per vCPU. Storage architecture features an integrated 1993 GB local NVMe solid-state drive with Premium Storage capabilities, offering low-latency scratch space for local file processing. Networking allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring private networking or supplementary public IP configuration.

Acceleration is driven by a partitioned NVIDIA Blackwell architecture RTX PRO 6000 GPU, allocated at a 0.25 share and granting 24 GB of dedicated video RAM. Partitioning the GPU provides a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage by allowing deployments to access modern graphics hardware and enterprise VRAM capacity without incurring the full resource footprint of a dedicated physical accelerator. This architecture balances high host CPU core counts, large system RAM, and extensive local NVMe disk capacity against fractional accelerator access.

The instance is structured for tasks requiring substantial CPU parallelism and high-throughput local disk storage alongside moderate GPU compute. Best-fit workloads include GPU-accelerated data processing, batch image rendering, computer-aided engineering pipelines, AI model inference, and local cache-intensive analytical operations. The primary architectural tradeoff centers on the fractional 0.25 GPU slice, which bounds aggregate graphics execution speed compared to full discrete GPU instances, making it suited for applications where CPU and disk throughput outweigh raw GPU processing demands.
description: Microsoft Azure NC36ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a specialized GPU-accelerated virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture, the instance provides 36 dedicated vCPUs alongside 132.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.67 GB of RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is delivered via a fractional partition of 0.25 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU with 24 GB of total video memory. Fast local caching and scratch space are facilitated by an integrated 1993 GB NVMe solid-state drive with support for Premium Storage. By allocating a fractional GPU slice alongside dedicated multi-core compute and substantial local disk space, the instance provides cost efficiency for graphics-oriented tasks and model inference that require high CPU and storage throughput without dedicating a full discrete graphics processor. Workload fit includes GPU-assisted data processing, moderate machine learning inference, computer-aided engineering, graphics rendering pipelines, and database-backed analytical operations.
